column1: # Stripped logs (the Felling worker: an axe strips a log; claude/tree-felling-df4d15). Side: the bark gone, the wood's own colour as in its planks and log top, long vertical grain. Top: the log top's rings out to the edge, no bark rim, a paler sapwood band.
# BLOCK_LIKE per image: each wood's log_<w>_top and planks_<w> (the tropical ones from the art-tropical worktree).

column3: log_oak_stripped|log|Stripped oak log side: the bark taken off, smooth bare oak wood in exactly the colour of the attached oak planks and log top (the inner wood, not the bark), long fine vertical grain lines running the full height, faint darker growth streaks and one or two small knots, a little darker and less even than the planks, no boards, no seams, seamless top to bottom
